name: tia_read_user_constant
description: Read a user constant's declared type and literal value from the selected PLC.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

table_name.description: Optional exact tag-table name. Omit only when the constant name resolves uniquely within the selected PLC and group scope.

group_path.description: Optional exact tag-table-group path. Use an empty string for the root group; may be used without table_name to scope the search.
